title: Descent and exponent independence of Cartier Kummer boundaries
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l and the families and normalizations of [def-amb-cartier-kummer-data]. Assume every positive quotient coefficient A_(E,n+1) is killed by some l^(r+1). For every ordinary etale Kummer family κ satisfying CartierEtaleKummerNormalization, there is exactly one family c with the published pro-etale Tate-line target satisfying CartierKummerRealization κ c simultaneously for every annihilating exponent. This asserts descent, exponent independence and uniqueness of the arrows only; it asserts neither coefficient-reduction compatibility, scheme-pullback compatibility nor a Chern equation.

source.place: Final scalar-extension sentence of paragraph 4; expanded existing proof steps 8--11 and the comparison-uniqueness portion of step 13.

proof.text: Use the existence component, which supplies a family realizing all annihilating exponents. It includes construction and exponent independence, but no uniqueness.

The ordinary closed-support quotient unit is epic by the etale open-closed short exact sequence. Exact inverse image preserves its epimorphism, so the quotient normalization uniquely fixes the supported-source isomorphism. Uniqueness of normalized root comparisons fixes the target isomorphism. Cancel precomposition by the source isomorphism in Ext; function extensionality gives uniqueness of the family. All formulas also apply to empty schemes, empty divisors and the zero coefficient ring.

proof_origin.place: Separate the existence component from the uniqueness argument. The latter is proved in Lean: epic quotient unit, preservation of epimorphisms by comparison inverse image, normalized root-comparison uniqueness, cancellation of Ext precomposition, and function extensionality.

lean.statement:
theorem cartier_kummer_descent
    (hkill : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ r : ℕ,
      ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0)
    (κ : CartierEtaleKummerFamily l E)
    (hκ : CartierEtaleKummerNormalization l E κ) :
    ∃! c : CartierKummerFamily l E, CartierKummerRealization l E κ c
